description: The role-growth rungs of the event-grounding sd-loop (Phase 3 of the graph-native event grounding: the Jabberwock grows its own argument roles). MIRRORS seeds/shape_decode_loop.json one level up: where that loop grows a CapabilityAxis from an unmatched shape residual, this loop grows a RoleFrame (a participant argument role) from an unmatched PARTICIPANT residual. The residual is an ANIMATE PP participant (WordNet animacy + the VerbNet prep->role table, precomputed on the EventClause as obl_animate/obl_role_ok/obl_canon_head) that NO RoleFrame in the event_roles codebook captured -- _ground_event marks it (role_residual=1, residual_head=<head>) as a mechanical residual OBSERVATION (I/O), and these rules DECIDE the growth: rf_mint_role mints a RoleFrame back from the residual (the thematic-oblique role, re-derived as graph data -- the earlier Python oblique patch now GROWN by the agent) + bumps codebook_epoch; rf_recognize clears a residual once a covering RoleFrame exists (no double-mint); rf_redecode re-arms a minted clause on codebook growth (the tick-driven re-decode, the same idiom sd_redecode uses). With the oblique RoleFrame present by default the residual never fires, so the corpus is byte-identical; the growth is demonstrated by booting WITHOUT the oblique RoleFrame (tests/test_role_growth_migrated.py): the animate PP is a residual, the agent mints the role, re-decode captures the dog. Loaded idempotently by reading_collapse._ensure_role_decode_loop via the Rust load_seed_manifest, guarded by a Seed{id:'role_decode_loop'} node.

microtheory.name: role_decode_loop
microtheory.description: an uncaptured animate participant is a residual; a novel argument role is minted from it via the sd loop, exactly as a CapabilityAxis is minted from an unmatched shape.

rules.name: rf_mint_role
rules.comment: GROW: an EventClause carrying a role residual (role_residual==1 -- an animate PP participant _ground_event observed but no RoleFrame emitted) and no role_minted edge yet (fixpoint safety) mints a RoleFrame back from it, PROVIDED no grown_oblique RoleFrame already exists (dedup -- one growth suffices; later clauses are then captured by it and never mark a residual). The minted RoleFrame is the thematic-oblique role re-derived as graph data: head_attr obl_canon_head + the oblique guard (animate + role-typed PP head distinct from subj/obj). Bumps codebook_epoch (Plus) so rf_redecode re-arms minted clauses, exactly as grow_part_library bumps it in the shape loop.

rules.name: rf_recognize
rules.comment: COVERED branch: an EventClause that marked a role residual but for which a grown_oblique RoleFrame now EXISTS (minted this fixpoint by rf_mint_role, or already present) is recognized -- clear its residual so it does not re-mint, and stamp status_role=recognized. This is the role analogue of sd_recognize (residual now explained by the grown codebook).

rules.name: rf_redecode
rules.comment: Codebook GROWTH closes the loop: a minted/recognized clause whose role_epoch lags the Agent's codebook_epoch (bumped by rf_mint_role) re-arms -- it stamps the current epoch so a subsequent re-ground reruns the RoleFrame consult against the grown codebook. This is the role analogue of sd_redecode; the actual re-ground is _ground_event's next invocation (mechanical), the same tick-driven idiom the shape loop uses. Guarded on status_role so a plain (never-residual) clause never matches.
